'''Lathin''' was a [[Child of the Light]] in service to [[Lord Captain]] [[Geofram Bornhald]].

==Activities==
In {{ne|998}}, Lathin and [[Yamwick]] were with a large group of the Children in an unknown, abandoned ''[[stedding]]''. While there, they discover [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Egwene al'Vere]]. After telling them to come out of their hiding place, [[Hopper]] attacks and kills Lathin. Perrin then attacks Yamwick after Hopper was killed by another Child.{{ref/book|1|30}} 

Almost [[1000 NE|two years later]], Child [[Oratar]] and Child [[Byar]] testify at a trial, held by [[Lord Captain Commander]] [[Galadedrid Damodred]] and judged by [[Morgase Trakand]], about the deaths.{{ref/book|13|34}} Byar insists that the killing of the Children makes Perrin a [[Darkfriend]].{{ref/book|13|35}}
